employee.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
employee.quote: think of Claude as a brilliant but new employee who lacks context on your norms and workflows

golden.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
golden.quote: show your prompt to a colleague with minimal context on the task and ask them to follow it. If they'd be confused, Claude will be too.

clear.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
clear.quote: Claude responds well to clear, explicit instructions.

context.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
context.quote: Providing context or motivation behind your instructions, such as explaining to Claude why such behavior is important, can help Claude better understand your goals and deliver more targeted responses.

examples.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
examples.quote: Examples are one of the most reliable ways to steer Claude's output format, tone, and structure.

diverse.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
diverse.quote: Diverse: Cover edge cases and vary enough that Claude doesn't pick up unintended patterns.

format.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
format.quote: Be specific about the desired output format and constraints.

positive.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
positive.quote: Tell Claude what to do instead of what not to do

xml.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
xml.quote: XML tags help Claude parse complex prompts unambiguously, especially when your prompt mixes instructions, context, examples, and variable inputs.

example-tags.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
example-tags.quote: wrap examples in <example> tags (multiple examples in <examples> tags) so Claude can distinguish them from instructions

tag-names.title: Anthropic: Prompting best practices
tag-names.quote: Use consistent, descriptive tag names across your prompts.

not-always.title: Anthropic: Prompt engineering overview
not-always.quote: Not every success criteria or failing eval is best solved by prompt engineering. For example, you can sometimes improve latency and cost more easily by selecting a different model.

languages.title: Anthropic: Multilingual support
languages.quote: Claude excels at tasks across multiple languages, maintaining strong cross-lingual performance relative to English.
